distribution.narrative: Beaver & Liu (2010) accepts Taiwan occurrence for the taxon treated there as Xyleborus metacuneolus. No mainland-China province is inferred from this source.

host_note: The source explicitly reports Buchanania, Mangifera and Swietenia and additionally describes the species as probably polyphagous. The three named genera are promoted at source resolution; broad polyphagy remains contextual.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Tricosa metacuneolus (Eggers, 1940).
